money_model: K_M balance exists on the authoritative settlement ledger; QR/card/phone are access and authorization surfaces, not the money itself.
security_invariants: No reusable spending secret in a static visible QR by default.
Payment requests include nonce/idempotency protection and expiration.
Lost/stolen credentials can be revoked without rewriting ownership history.

offline_mode.reason: Offline value introduces double-spend and reconciliation risk; any future design must be separately modeled and bounded.
